rationale: The entry thesis remains valid as OCTV continues to consolidate tightly near the top of its daily range (94.2%) on very light pullback volume (averaging ~2,400 shares per 1-minute bar since entry). Price is currently testing and holding right at the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($21.41) well above the $21.37 invalidation level, while the broad market tailwind has strengthened further (SPY +4.84%, VIXY -15.45%). With risk strictly bounded to $8 total on the trade ($0.09/share) and no evidence of heavy selling supply, holding to allow the consolidation to resolve upward is warranted.
